chapter: West Coast trip and Mildred's circle
title: Hearing Rinker and Crosby at the De Marco Theater
summary: Recovering, he walks into a Los Angeles theater and is knocked out by Al Rinker and Bing Crosby performing as a duo.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: I was getting strength back and finally one day I walked around the park, after a few days I got so I could walk pretty well. So one day I walked out of the park on the other side and I walked down and here was Rube Wolfe working in a [transho De- Marco] Theater. So I was -- felt kind of whoozy, and I thought, well I'll go in. And I went in and sat down. And guess who knocked me clean out, when I heard him?
Oh, no kidding, is that right?
they were a duo. Yeah, (unintelligible) Al was playing the piano, and Bing had a little cymbal on the piano. And they were scatting and singing, there -- Bing was doing --
-- like the cymbal beats and I thought they were the greatest thing I'd ever heard.
Well listen, was Al Mildred's Milton's brother?
Well, I'll be, but what a funny thing.
Were they, maybe, three or four years older than you at that point?
Oh, yeah, I was very -- I think at that point -- well I'm 69 now, I think Bing is -- Al is 70-something I don't know how much --
About four or five years older.
Oh, I just had dinner at his house before I left California .
